memories.content: Bao runs a well-reviewed banh mi food truck. He wants to secure a regular weekend parking spot at a brewery. He plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday. He knows that two of the breweries already host rotating food trucks, and the third never has.

Bao Tran plans to visit three breweries in person on Saturday, August 8, 2026, between 10:00 and 20:00 local time, to ask their managers about parking his food truck on their lots. The breweries are open during that time. Two of the breweries already host rotating food trucks; the third never has.
